{{Top|leg}}
A '''slug hunter''' was an individual who [[Hunting/Legends|hunted]] [[Exogorth/Legends|space slugs]], large [[Realspace/Legends|space]]-borne creatures that inhabited [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid fields]].<ref name="Smart Space Slug">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20020919slug|series=Creature Feature|text=Smart Space Slug}}</ref>

The hunters sought out the slugs due to the various industrial and cosmetic applications of space slug skin and organs. Slug hunters would explore [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] fields for [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] on end in search of slugs to hunt. Once they located a target space slug, the hunters would typically venture into the creature's [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] and [[Death/Legends|kill]] it using [[Heavy blaster rifle/Legends|heavy blaster weapons]] such as the [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web blaster]].<ref name="Smart Space Slug" />

On one occasion, a group of slug hunters targeted the intelligent space slug [[Turmok]] and entered its mouth dressed in [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Environment suit/Legends|space suits]], intending to open fire with E-Web [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and slay the slug. However, Turmok shut its mouth and shook the hunters to death, then proceeded to pull their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] inside its mouth too.<ref name="Smart Space Slug" />

==Behind the scenes==
Slug hunters were mentioned in the [[Wizards.com]] article ''Smart Space Slug'', written by [[Jeff Quick]]. The article was published on [[September 19]] [[2002]] as part of the ''[[Creature Feature]]'' article series and served as a supplement to [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Smart Space Slug" />
